articles.summary: As Thanksgiving approaches, we’re reminded of the people who make this season—and every season—run smoothly. At Marten, that gratitude begins with our drivers. The long hours, the miles, the commitment to safety, the sacrifices made away from home—these actions fuel our success, our customers’ success, and the communities that rely on timely deliveries during the…
articles.title: MESSAGES OF THANKS: DISPATCHERS SHARE WHY MARTEN IS SO GRATEFUL FOR OUR DRIVERS
